description: Canonical registry of every container image referenced by an executable file in this repository. Executable image references are projections of this registry: the governance test rewrites nothing, it fails when a reference drifts. Digests are multi-platform index digests, resolved from the upstream registry and verified to carry a linux/amd64 manifest.

images.rationale: PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector, the database every required CI gate runs against.
PostgreSQL 15 with pgvector. Used by the Planning Studio gate, the disposable ARIA and NPC real-database suites, and the Core migration rehearsals, which must reproduce the production major version.
Plain PostgreSQL 16, used by the gate that must prove the schema applies without the pgvector extension present.
Redis 7, backing rate limiting and queue state in the E2E and integration gates.
SMTP sink proving outbox delivery end to end without reaching a real mail provider.

Reference only. Production terminates TLS on a host Nginx under PM2, not in a container; the compose service that named this image is commented out. Registered so the reference cannot silently become executable without review.
